description: This file defines a React functional component 'ViewDetailsModal' which renders a modal dialog displaying detailed information about a JSON data object. It uses a custom Modal component and a utility function formatLabel to format keys. It handles rendering of various data types and provides a user interface for viewing details of arbitrary data objects.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Converts a value to a string for display, handling null/undefined, primitives, and objects/arrays with JSON serialization.
